claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: RS-67333 is a 5-HT4 receptor partial agonist that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would likely be weak and non-selective, possibly via off-target cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress, but the compound is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
